name: sun-moon
title: Sun / Moon
description: A theme toggle that rotates and crossfades between a sun and a moon.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels.

props.name: moon
props.description: Controlled moon state. When omitted the icon manages its own state.

props.name: onToggle
props.description: Called with the next moon state whenever the icon is toggled.

accessibility: Renders as a button with role="button", aria-pressed reflecting the moon state, and an accessible label. Toggles on Enter and Space.
touch: Hover scale is gated behind a (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) check. Tapping toggles the sun/moon crossfade directly.
reducedMotion: The rotation is dropped; the sun and moon crossfade with a short 150ms opacity transition.
